ami.name: AMI du quartier
ami.need: Bring the Marais flagship store to life: invite customers to share geotagged “friendship moments” around the neighborhood, building a bond with the brand and drawing people into the store.
done: Two-level interactive map: neighborhood zones first, then individual places on zoom
Private addresses anonymized and grouped by street, points of interest pinned individually
Filters by type of moment, managed from the back office
Feed that alternates personal, community, AMI-curated and brand content depending on the user’s profile

About.label: (04) About
About.bio: I started out as a mechanical engineer and became a full stack developer because I love building useful things. That path taught me to listen, understand the need, ask the right questions, then deliver a clean product. Based in Paris, my goal comes down to choosing the right tools, testing, and shipping a product where I own every detail.
